summary: Reference table of au.* audio console variables and commands for debugging sounds at runtime: 3D visualization, on-screen sound/cue/mix/modulator debug views, active sound dumps, memory reports, stream cache, MetaSound, Quartz and virtual-loop tuning. Also explains opening the console and using `<CVar> ?` for help.
keys: Project Settings > Engine > Input > Console Keys
gotchas: au.IsUsingAudioMixer only takes effect if the audio device is not in use unless au.AllowUnsafeAudioMixerToggling is 1; sounds stop and loops do not resume
au.editor.ForceAudioNonStreaming may cause a DDC miss
On British English keyboards the console key is the grave key

summary: Explains the Audio Gameplay Volumes plugin, the component-based replacement for legacy Audio Volumes, with Attenuation, Filter, Reverb, Submix Override and Submix Send components plus Primitive and Condition proxies. Covers priority between overlapping volumes and that processing runs on the audio thread.
gotchas: Beta feature: use caution when shipping
Each component has a Priority that decides which applies when the listener is in multiple volumes

summary: Step-by-step setup of an AudioGameplayVolume with a Reverb component in the First Person template: create a Sound Class with Apply Ambient Volumes and a 2D reverb send, place the volume, add a Reverb component and Reverb Effect asset, then test in PIE.
gotchas: Beta feature
Audio Gameplay Volumes plugin is disabled by default
Requires Sound Waves to use a Sound Class with Apply Ambient Volumes enabled
Attenuation and Filter components need a sound positioned away from the player to be heard

summary: Tutorial for Audio Gameplay Volume Proxy components: build a Blueprint actor with a Reverb component plus an AGV Primitive Proxy (static mesh collision, rescaled with mouse wheel) and an AGV Condition Proxy driven by the AudioGameplayCondition interface (Condition Met / Condition Met Position).
gotchas: Beta feature
Primitive Proxies do not support Actors with multiple Static Mesh components (warning in Output log)
Listener defaults to the camera; third-person setups may need a Condition Proxy to use the character
Static mesh needs custom collision set to Overlap with Generate Overlap Events disabled

summary: High-level tour of the Unreal Audio Engine: importing Sound Waves, Sound Cues, attenuation/spatialization/occlusion, PlaySound vs SpawnSound Blueprint APIs, Sound Classes, Sound Mixes and ducking, modulation, concurrency and voice limits, DSP/submixes, cooking compression and debug commands.
gotchas: PlaySound functions are fire-and-forget; use SpawnSound to get an Audio Component for control, attachment or loops
Multichannel (quad/5.1/7.1) sources only support 2D playback
Imported audio is stored as 16-bit uncompressed .wav

summary: Glossary defining audio terms as used in Unreal: codecs (ADPCM, Bink Audio, Ogg Vorbis), attenuation, audio bus vs submix vs source bus, control bus, modulation terms, MetaSound, Quartz, sound class mix, concurrency, listener and more.
gotchas: 24-bit audio import is supported only on Windows; 16-bit on all editor platforms
Listener is on the camera by default
Audio Volumes are intended to be replaced by Audio Gameplay Volumes; Sound Class Mixes by Audio Modulation

summary: Overview contrasting legacy audio features (Sound Cues, Sound Classes, Sound Mixes) with UE5 features: MetaSounds as the DSP-graph replacement for Sound Cues, Audio Modulation parameter buses, Quartz sample-accurate scheduling, and Audio Analysis.
gotchas: Sound Cues are not sample-accurate and cannot build arbitrary DSP

summary: Architecture deep dive of the multi-platform Audio Mixer renderer: platform layer, buffer generation and underruns/overruns, audio vs audio render threads, encoded/procedural/source-bus sources, per-source DSP and source effect chains, and the submix graph with master reverb/EQ submixes, analysis and recording.
gotchas: Underruns (usually CPU saturation) cause pops, stutters or dropouts
The audio thread is fenced during garbage collection and not used in the editor

summary: Reference for the per-platform Audio section in Project Settings > Platforms: mixer sample rate, callback buffer size, max channels, source workers, spatialization/reverb/occlusion plugin, compression overrides, cook overrides and stream caching sizes, written to (PlatformName)Engine.ini.
gotchas: Values of 0 or lower are ignored in favour of global audio settings
Max Channels uses the smaller of platform and global values
Stream Caching cook override is marked Experimental; audio may not be playable immediately on load

summary: Describes the Audio Insights Output Metering and Analyzers panels for the final mix: LUFS loudness meters (ITU-R BS.1770), RMS meter, oscilloscope, vectorscope, spectrogram and spectrum analyzer with their FFT/CQT and display options.
gotchas: Loudness, Oscilloscope, Vectorscope, Spectrogram and Spectrum Analyzer are editor-only

summary: Tour of Audio Insights toolbars (Monitoring vs Recording to .utrace, snapshots, bookmarks, audio-only tracing, world filter), the shared cache timeline controls, and the Event Log with columns, event types (including concurrency stop/play errors) and custom event categories.
keys: Create New Audio Device for Play in Editor
gotchas: Stopping PIE may change the audio device and delete cached events; disable Create New Audio Device for Play in Editor to keep them
Monitoring, Recording and Audio Only Tracing are editor only
Ctrl+M places a bookmark

summary: How to attach Audio Insights to a standalone Windows build (or networked console build) via Unreal Insights: launch UnrealInsights.exe, connect with audio,audiomixer channels, run the game with -messaging, open the LIVE trace, or monitor without saving a trace file.
gotchas: Standalone Audio Insights requires Unreal Insights as a bridge
Enter audio,audiomixer with no space after the comma
Standalone mode lacks some messaging available with PIE
Monitoring without a trace file is not possible for networked console builds

summary: Opening Audio Insights from Tools > Audio Insights and monitoring a PIE session, starting a recorded trace, arranging tabs, and using the editor-only Logs and Details panels.
gotchas: Monitoring alone does not save data; click Start Recording to save a trace
Logs and Details panels are editor-only

summary: Describes the Audio Insights Modulation dashboard, which lists live Control Buses, Bus Mixes, Generators and Parameter Patches with values, bypass states and contributing modulators.
gotchas: Requires the Audio Modulation Insights plugin
Bus Mixes show no value because they are containers

summary: Covers the Audio Insights Submixes, Audio Buses, Signal Flow graph and Audio Meters tabs: selecting submixes/buses to meter, the live node graph of source-to-bus-to-submix routing with toolbar shortcuts and path highlighting, and per-channel dB meters.
gotchas: Only submixes/buses with the Select checkbox enabled send meter data; select them before recording a trace
Selecting submixes or buses for metering is disabled when reading a trace file

summary: Explains the Audio Insights Sounds tab (live per-sound volume, pitch, distance, attenuation, LPF/HPF, priority, render cost, mute/solo), the Plots tab for 5-second parameter histories, and the Virtual Loops tab for tracked but inaudible sounds.
gotchas: Solo takes precedence over mute
Muted and Soloed columns are editor only
Plots show only the most recent 5 seconds

summary: Explains audio stream caching: sizing Max Cache Size, priming sounds (Prime Sound For Playback), Prime on Load / Retain on Load loading behaviour, Trim Audio Cache, what blowing the cache means, and cvars for minimum cache usage, over-budget trimming and read priority.
gotchas: A loaded USoundWave is not guaranteed to be immediately playable
au.streamcaching.MinimumCacheUsage must be set before IAudioStreamingManager initializes
TrimAudioCache locks the cache and can cause streaming underruns
Primed Sound Cues fire no completion delegate

summary: Reference for Sound Concurrency assets: Max Count, Limit to Owner, Resolution Rules, Retrigger Time, volume-scaling ducking and voice steal release, plus assigning a project default or per-source Concurrency Set and overrides.
gotchas: All active components count toward Max Count, including silent synths; Source Buses take two slots
Volume Scale is applied after Stop Quietest rules
Sources must satisfy every concurrency in a Concurrency Set to play

summary: How to create Audio Buses, start them (Default Audio Buses or Start Audio Bus node), send sources via pre/post-effect bus sends, use them for audio-rate modulation (Filter, Ring Modulation source effects), and make them audible with a Source Bus or a MetaSound Audio Bus Reader; compares buses with submixes.
gotchas: An Audio Bus must be started before it receives audio
Audio Buses are not audible by default
Source Buses only support Mono or Stereo; use a MetaSound Source for more channels
Source Bus Duration of 0 plays indefinitely

summary: Hub page for Audio Modulation topics; no content beyond tags.

Reference for Sound Class assets: volume/pitch/LPF/attenuation scale, child class inheritance, passive Sound Mix modifiers, routing (Apply Ambient Volume), legacy flags like Is UISound and Is Music, default submix and reverb sends, modulation settings and loading behaviour.
gotchas: Low Pass Filter Frequency of 20,000 or above has no effect
Force Inline also requires each Sound Wave's Loading Behavior Override set to Force Inline
Radio filter settings only work on Windows/Xbox with the XAudio2 backend

summary: Introduces the Audio Modulation plugin: patch-cable model of connectors (Control Buses, Parameter Patches, Generators), modulators (Control Bus Mixes) and destinations (Sound Waves, MetaSound Sources, Audio/Synth Components, Sound Classes, Submixes, some Source Effects).
gotchas: Plugin is disabled by default and requires an editor restart after enabling
Only BitCrusher and Chorus source effects are modulation destinations

summary: Builds a volume Control Bus hierarchy: create CB_ buses with the Volume parameter, assign them to the Master Sound Class and a MetaSound Source, create and activate a Control Bus Mix, debug with the modulation matrix, and drive it from Blueprint with Activate Control Bus Mix and Set Control Bus Mix By Filter.
keys: Set Control Bus Mix By Filter
gotchas: Requires Audio Modulation and MetaSound plugins enabled and a restart
Modulation ignores Sound Class hierarchy: each Sound Class must list all its Control Buses
Only one instance of a given mix can be active at a time
Bus Parameter list needs Show Plugin/Engine Content enabled

summary: Full reference for Audio Modulation assets (Modulation Parameters, Control Buses, Control Bus Mixes with profiles, Parameter Patches, LFO/Envelope Follower/AD Envelope generators), destination routing options, MetaSound nodes, concurrency cvar, Blueprint API and the UObject-vs-proxy update model.
gotchas: Plugin is disabled by default
Functions that only edit the UObject need an Update call to reach the audio-thread proxy
Modulation runs at block rate, not sample rate
Unit Display Name is stripped from packaged builds

summary: How to use the legacy Audio Volume Ambient Zone Settings to change interior/exterior sound volume and low-pass filtering when the player enters or leaves a volume, with a worked setup using two Ambient Sound actors and a Sound Class with Apply Ambient Volumes.
gotchas: Must rebuild level geometry after placing a Sound Actor inside the zone
Sounds need a Sound Class with Apply Ambient Volumes enabled

summary: Overview of AudioLink, an API that streams PCM from Unreal sources, submixes or Audio Components to external audio engines; covers enabling sends via Sound Attenuation and submix settings, AudioLinkBlueprintInterface, limitations and troubleshooting.
gotchas: Beta feature
Hardware decoders unsupported; max eight channels; no ambisonic or object-based formats
Sending the same signal via source and submix stacks into loud audio
Each editor/PIE window has its own audio engine instance, so a factory can miss early submixes

summary: C++ reference for implementing an AudioLink plugin: IAudioLinkFactory registration, UAudioLinkSettingsAbstract and IAudioLinkSettingsProxy, settings UFactory, IAudioLink instances, IBufferedAudioOutput buffers and IAudioLinkSynchronizer callbacks, with code examples.
gotchas: Beta feature
Only one factory can be registered; extra factories assert fatally on startup
Factory functions must not return null (asserts) and should be thread-safe
Buffer size should be at least 2:1 of the consumer bitrate to avoid underruns

summary: Overview of the OSC (Open Sound Control) plugin for sending and receiving OSC messages and bundles over the network from Blueprint or C++: OSC Server/Client, FOSCAddress patterns, Blueprint API, example node graphs and osc.* console commands.
gotchas: Plugin must be enabled under Edit > Plugins > Input Devices
Based on the OSC 1.0 protocol; types are transient and created in Blueprint

summary: Tutorial building a stereo procedural music MetaSound Source (Trigger Repeat tempo, random melody from Scale to Note Array, sine/saw synths, crossfade, ladder filter with LFO, AD envelope, stereo delay) and a Blueprint actor whose trigger boxes change BPM, crossfade and melody via audio parameters.
gotchas: Remove the UE.Source.OneShot interface for persistent sounds like music
Set Float Parameter and Execute Trigger Parameter nodes may require turning off Context Sensitive search
